shortDescription: An earthquake of magnitude 7 struck China's Tibet at around 10:33 p.m. local time (1433 GMT) on Thursday, the China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC) said.The epicentre was in a county in Nagqu, northern Tibet, at a depth of 10 km (6.21 miles), CENC data showed.
